messages:
Anna K: uploaded 34B-mqa weights to gs://redwood-models/onboard/phoenix-34b-v1/weights.tar.gz and pushed tokenizer files to gs://redwood-models/onboard/phoenix-34b-v1/tokenizer/. Can someone quick-check RoPE scale and sliding-window defaults before I open the PR?
Miguel R: @Anna K quick sanity: are these the training rope params or post-train adjusted? Our runtime applies legacy MQA scaling unless rope_scale is explicitly set in model config. :eyes:
Anna K: training config had rope_scale=1.00012 (float32). I left rope_scale unset in the metadata because some runtimes prefer implicit scaling. Should I force it in the model config?
Sasha P: force it. we've had drift where implicit scaling picked the wrong legacy path. Also tokenizer: the sentencepiece that arrived has an extra <unk> token at id=3, leads to off-by-one in some tokenizers. Run spm_export_vocab to verify.
Anna K: noted. I'll update tokenizer meta and include a note in the PR.
Sasha P: local config I used for smoke: 
```yaml
model: phoenix-34b-v1
weights_path: gs://redwood-models/onboard/phoenix-34b-v1/weights.tar.gz
mqa: true
rope_scale: 1.00012
sliding_window: 2048
attention_impl: auto   # fallback to attention_v2 if rope mismatch
tokenizer: 
  type: sentencepiece
  path: gs://redwood-models/onboard/phoenix-34b-v1/tokenizer/tokenizer.model
```
Miguel R: couple of runtime notes: 1) sliding_window >= 2048 will flip to streaming KV layout on rigs with 80GB ddr; 2) for GQA mapping ensure num_qk_heads matches training (we auto-map if mapping table present but double-check).
Leo Z: I can run an internal serve smoke later today. ping me when PR is up. I'll run batch=1 seq=2048 and a 1-token streaming extension test to validate KV offsets.
Anna K: PR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/inference-ops/pulls/1284 — includes weightpaths, tokenizer meta (with explicit unk handling), and rope_scale set. Please review when you get a sec.
deploy-bot: CI started: model-compat-checker/phoenix-34b-v1 (job id: mc-4521)
Miguel R: I kicked a quick compatibility run against the runtime test matrix. Short log: 
```
[mc-4521] start compatibility run
[mc-4521] tokenizer: sentencepiece loaded, vocab_size=50288, extra_unk=1 -> corrected mapping
[mc-4521] rope: found rope_scale=1.00012, applied legacy-mqa scaling -> OK
[mc-4521] attention: attention_v2 selected for MQA; fallback verified
[mc-4521] sliding-window: 2048 -> streaming KV path engaged (latency +3ms)
[mc-4521] result: PASS (minor latency reg flagged)
```
Anna K: nice, thanks. Any action items from the latency reg?
Miguel R: none blocking; file a perf ticket to track quant/batching tweaks for this family. I'll add notes about the small latency bump and where it came from (KV layout change).
qa-bot: compat-summary: RoPE scale match, tokenizer mapping adjusted, GQA/MQA head mapping ok, sliding-window uses streaming kv path. Recommend canary rollout behind dedicated capacity for 24h.
Leo Z: I'll do canary in staging today and report numbers. :thumbsup:
Anna K: thanks everyone — I'll merge once staging canary looks stable and then schedule gradual rollout.
